rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for consuming goods or services, especially in economic contexts.

example.english: My online consumption came to over a thousand dollars this month.
example.traditional: 呢個月我喺網上消費咗成千蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyut6 ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 siu1 fai3 zo2 seng4 cin1 man1

rows.note: Use this for the using-up, depletion, or destructive side of consumption rather than simply eating.

example.english: Long hours of air-conditioning lead to a lot of electricity consumption.
example.traditional: 長時間開住冷氣會消耗好多電。
example.jyutping: coeng4 si4 gaan1 hoi1 zyu6 laang5 hei3 wui5 siu1 hou3 hou2 do1 din6

rows.note: Use this only when consumption means eating and drinking, including dietary habits.

example.english: Their food-and-drink consumption has become much lighter recently.
example.traditional: 佢最近飲食清淡咗好多。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 jam2 sik6 cing1 daam6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when consumption means the quantity used, especially for fuel, energy, or materials.

example.english: This car's petrol consumption is lower than before.
example.traditional: 呢部車嘅汽油用量比以前低。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 hei3 jau4 jung6 loeng6 bei2 ji5 cin4 dai1
